sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The egg is a symbolic object in Celtic iconography. Eggs appear with goddesses of abundance such as Sirona. An egg is a clear sign of potential life. It may also promise rebirth, for eggs appear among grave goods. Some eggs held magic. The crimson eggs of Clídna's birds gave the eater power to shape-shift. The serpent's stone, that magical egg-shaped object, may represent an egg.
